verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Weave Service API with REST endpoints and a published OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec. Nothing in the pack shows API versioning (version paths, headers, or stability tiers) or a documented deprecation policy. Having an OpenAPI spec is adjacent to this story but does not deliver it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
